name: Render views
about: The views rendered quickly in Blender on a PC, each with a mask that protects the products, then enhanced by Krea within a budget; you review each result beside its reference and the render before it. In a project the Objects come from the model, each from its detailed version (those without one show their plain 3D shape and are listed), and kept results go to Renders/; in the studio the scene is uploaded and approved results stay with the run.
useWhen: The owner wants images of the project's views (from the cameras of its Blender scene) for a review or a client, matching the brief's reference images.

input.about: In a project: the scene (.blend) and reference images (named like the cameras, e.g. CAM_SLIDE51.jpg) from its files. In the studio: upload them. In the notes: which cameras, the pass (faithful, realism or masked edit) and the credit budget.

rules.text: Blender gets the geometry, colours and light right in a quick render; resolution and fine detail come from the enhance step.
Products are protected: the furniture, feature walls, ceiling raft, pendants and plants are black in the mask, and an edit may change only the white areas.
Every Krea call is quoted first; nothing runs above the budget the owner set (400 credits when none is set).
Colours are kept as rendered; a result that changes a product's shape or colour is not offered.
Only the owner's review puts images in the project's files, in Renders/, and nothing there is overwritten.

steps.name: Check the detail
steps.outcome: Every Object placed in the project is known to have its detailed version, or is listed as rendered with its plain 3D shape.

steps.name: Render
steps.outcome: Each camera has a quick render and a product mask: <CAMERA>_cycles.png and <CAMERA>_mask.png.

steps.name: Enhance
steps.outcome: Each render is enhanced by Krea within the budget, its products unchanged: <CAMERA>_enhanced.png.

steps.name: Review
steps.question: Does each result match its reference, with the products unchanged? Keep the ones that pass; or pin a comment on an image and send it back.

output.name: Views
output.about: Each view made, and the ones kept in the project's files (Renders/).
